the initiation of DNA synthesis in E. coli is not a single event but a complex process that involves the interaction of several factors, including the availability of deoxynucleoside triphosphates, the presence of an appropriate temperature and the presence of an active RNA polymerase.
the nalidixate block of DNA synthesis in E. coli is a block at the DNA replication step, that is, the block is not at the initiation step.
